# Sagar Sutaria

> Senior engineering practice operating from Ahmedabad, India. Fractional CTO retainers and fixed-scope build engagements through QuantaLynk Technologies Private Limited. Thirteen plus years shipping production systems across HR, real time marketplaces, AI enabled SaaS, and content streaming.

This site is the founder voice for the QuantaLynk studio. Personal essays, architecture writeups, and engagement notes live here. The studio's commercial surface is at https://quantalynk.com.

## About the practice

QuantaLynk operates as a senior solo practice with senior contractors brought in on specific scopes. Three to four engagements per quarter cap. The studio walks from anything outside that capacity, regardless of price. Pricing reflects an Ahmedabad delivery base, not a discount on quality.

Founder: Sagar Sutaria. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sagar-sutaria. Studio entity: https://quantalynk.com.
